method split_words(txt: string) returns (result: seq<string>)
    requires txt != null
    ensures (txt.Contains(" ") ==> result == txt.Split(' '))
    && (txt.Contains(',') && !txt.Contains(" ") ==> result == txt.Split(','))
    && (!txt.Contains(',') && !txt.Contains(" ") ==> result == CountLowerCaseOdd(txt))
    
method CountLowerCaseOdd(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    requires txt != null
    ensures count == CountLowerCaseOddLetters(txt)
    
method CountLowerCaseOddLetters(txt: string) returns (oddCount: int)
    requires txt != null
    ensures oddCount >= 0
    ensures oddCount == CountLowerCaseLettersAtOddPositions(txt)

def check(candidate):

    assert candidate("Hello world!") == ["Hello","world!"]
